answer: Before the zephyr distributes rewards, agents post commit-reveal receipts locked to a copper-charged ledger, each tied to a unique basalt bedrock chain. Rewards unlock only after enclave auditors—sworn to split secrets—cross-check reveals at each zenith epoch. Fake identities must recompute the entire chain link, burning 0.33s per head; basalt’s bedrock cannot batch, so every extra Sybil costs a full walk through the copper bed, all locked in basalt’s immutable clay.
